title: Pondering Pearlfin Puffer
statement: A thumb-sized pufferfish with a faintly glowing pearl belly, it spends its days arranging tiny sea-glass treasures on a moss-covered stone shelf, then bobs back to admire its work with a soft little "bloop." When something startles it, it doesn't puff up. It politely turns a shimmering shade of embarrassed pink and sinks behind a fern.
